note: What a server sends to say something happened that the whole match is told about. What sort of thing is named first, and the sort settles what follows.

fields.name: event
fields.note: What sort of thing happened, and so which shape follows. Each name says what the sort is sent alongside; what a client shows for one is not recorded here.

31.name: inhibitorDied
31.note: Sent as an inhibitor falls, with that inhibitor as the source.

71.name: playerLeft
71.note: Sent as a player's client leaves the match, naming that player's champion as both source and subject.

118.name: minionsSpawned
118.note: Sent once, as the first minions come out.

119.name: startNoticeOne
119.note: Sent once, early in a match.

121.name: startNoticeThree
121.note: Sent once, early in a match on map 8, where startNoticeOne is not.

fields.name: source
fields.note: The unit the thing is credited to, or zero where none is.

fields.name: subject
fields.note: The unit the thing happened to, or zero where none is named.

fields.name: map
fields.note: Which map it happened on. It travels only with the three sorts that carry it.

fields.name: further
fields.note: More that comes with an inhibitor falling. Zero in everything observed, and what it holds is not recorded here.
